verdict.rationale: OpenClaw does expose HTTP surfaces, including an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint and a direct tool-invoke endpoint, so a downloadable API spec is a fair ask. However, the probe found no OpenAPI/Swagger document at any candidate path, and no doc mentions a published spec. The A2A Agent Card and the MCP server mode are agent-discovery and tool protocols, not a downloadable spec of the Gateway's API, so they are not credited here.
